description: This file defines a Java interface 'DaemonTokenAware', which is used to allow modules or components to receive a daemon token for executing code on behalf of a daemon user within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: DaemonTokenAware
classes.description: An interface that allows implementing classes to receive a daemon token for performing actions as a daemon user.

methods.name: setDaemonToken
methods.description: Method to pass the daemon token to the implementing class, which can then use it for authenticated actions.
